rows.en: Ymir: "Lady Ivel... I'll be going now."
Ivel: "Yes, off you go.
...And follow the path you believe in."
Ymir: "...Yes."
Ivel: "...Now, Valga, Rishuna.
I'm counting on you."
Rishuna: "Yes. I'll help in whatever small way I can."
Valga: "Though I pray we won't be needed.
Overexertion is hard on these old bones."
Rishuna: "Valga?!"
Touya: "Don't worry. We'll settle this properly ourselves.
We won't put you to any trouble."
Valga: "Yes. That's the spirit.
Even if you have only a handful of chances to win, give up at the start,
and you'll be left empty-handed."
Clovis: "Hey, hey. We've only got a 'handful' of chances?"
Valga: "Hohohoho. It's a figure of speech, a figure of speech."
Touya: "All right... Let's go!"
Kasumi: "Let's do our best."
Sharl: "...Have you finished the embroidery?"
Doris: "Yes. Though I haven't given it to him yet."
Sharl: "Would you happen to have it with you now?"
Doris: "Yes. You told me not to do anything unnecessary.
Though I imagine that wasn't your only reason..."
Sharl: "..."
Doris: "..."
Sharl: "...I hope you can give it to him... safely."
Doris: "Yes..."
Sharl: "Then it's about time we went.
They have those people with them.
It's only a matter of time before they cross the 'Sorge Field.'"
Touya: "...Speaking of which, around Alterias Valley...
What are we going to do about that barrier, whatever it's called?"
Celica: "The 'Sorge Field.' Don't worry about that.
I can't exactly say I foresaw this happening...
But I built a barrier-breaching device, 'Charge Buddy No. 3.'"
Touya: "...What happened to Nos. 1 and 2?"
Celica: "Well, let's leave those little details aside.
I've installed it on Liebhofen, so we're all set."
Valga: "We helped her with it too."
Yamato: "I don't really get it, but I'm amazed you found the time
to build something like that."
Celica: "Well, you know. Though I haven't slept because of it."
Valga: "I made sure to get a good night's sleep."
Rishuna: "Valga, you don't have to make a point of announcing
every little thing..."
Valga: "And here I thought I was holding back..."
Celica: "Anyway, that's how it is, so don't worry.
Let's go."
Yamato: "Well, shall we get going?"
Touya: "Yeah... Next time we come back here, it'll be to collect
our things. So we can leave this ship."
Yamato: "Right. Let's make sure we come back."
Touya: "Hmm? ...Come in."
Touya: "Hmm? What's wrong?"
Ymir: "...Touya..."
Touya: "W-What is it?"
Yamato: "Oh, should I... go on ahead...?"
Ymir: "No, Yamato. You stay too."
Yamato: "O-Okay..."
Ymir: "...I've been... thinking...
What am I actually doing?
I send everyone off into mortal danger,
then watch the battle from the safety of the bridge...
Is that really all I can do...?"
Touya: "...That's not true.
It's because you and the others support us, Ymir,
that we can focus on fighting without worrying."
Ymir: "...That's what I thought too. What I've tried to think...
But I can't. Touya, you risked your life to save me.
And all I can do is see you off...
I felt how powerless I was.
The next Matriarch? The Chief Alchemical Scholar? What a joke...
People fawn over me, calling me a once-in-a-century genius,
but I couldn't even tell you how I felt.
And when you went off to risk your life in battle,
I couldn't do anything at all..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "When you came to save me, Touya,
I was so happy.
I wanted to throw myself into your arms, Touya...
But I didn't have the courage.
And you kept encouraging me afterward, Touya...
I was so happy...
Then I wondered what I'd been doing all this time,
and I regretted it so much... My heart hurt so, so badly.
Whenever I thought of you, I couldn't stop crying...
It was only then that I finally understood.
Ah, I really do love Touya.
I'm in love with him...
Of course, I'd had feelings for you before then too.
But somewhere in my heart, I hesitated.
What would I do if I confessed and you turned me down?
I knew I'd never recover.
But that just meant I was afraid of getting hurt,
and running away. Just like I always had..."
Touya: "..."
Ymir: "...When I cried in your arms, Touya, your kindness
wrapped itself around me... And I made up my mind.
I wouldn't run away anymore. So... So, please.
Let me aboard Rayblade."
Touya: "Was that why you asked Miyasco and Celica?"
Ymir: "Yes. I was still practicing then, and I wasn't
confident. So I couldn't bring myself to tell you properly..."
Touya: "But..."
Ymir: "Despite how I may seem, my pilot aptitude
has been rated highly."
Touya: "What?! H-Hey, don't joke..."
Ymir: "I'm serious. I've been practicing piloting for this.
Despite how I may seem, my pilot aptitude has been rated highly."
Yamato: "But no matter how much you've practiced...
Real combat isn't the same as practice, you know?"
Ymir: "Of course I know.
I know I'm asking too much.
But I don't want any more regrets.
When someone I love is risking his life to fight,
I can't just do nothing for him.
Please grant me this one selfish wish. My first and last...
Please, let me be with you."
Yamato: "Ymir... Your feelings for Touya are that strong..."
Touya: "..."
...All right.
Ymir: "Touya..."
Touya: "I'm sorry. I didn't realize you were so troubled, Ymir,
or how much you were hurting..."
Ymir: "No... I... I..."
Touya: "H-Hey, don't cry..."
Ymir: "I-I'm sorry... They just keep coming...
Ehehe... I must look awful..."
Touya: "Not at all.
Ymir... Let's make sure we win. And then..."
Ymir: "And then...?"
Touya: "Let's pick up where we left off last time."
Ymir: "Where we left off...? Oh..."
Touya: "Just kidding..."
Ymir: "...All right..."
Touya: "Huh?! No, I was joking..."
Ymir: "...If it's you, Touya... all right..."
Touya: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "Touya..."
Yamato: "U-Um... I'm terribly sorry
to interrupt you two...
But shouldn't you be getting ready...?"
Ymir: "!?"
Touya: "Huh?!"
Ymir: "...Y-Yes, you're right..."
Touya: "Y-Yeah... Sh-Shall we go...?"
Ymir: "...Oh... I see..."
Touya: "I'm glad you feel that way, but...
I just can't put you in danger."
Ymir: "..."
Yamato: "Th-That's right. Ymir, there are things that Ymir alone
can do, aren't there?"
Ymir: "...Huh?"
Yamato: "If you come with us, Ymir,
who's going to protect Liebhofen? Even if we win,
what would we do if we had nowhere to come back to?
And... Knowing someone's waiting for you gives you
a reason to come home, you know?"
Ymir: "...Sniff... Th-Thank you...
You're right. I... was forcing my feelings on you...
I'm sorry..."
Touya: "N-No, you don't have to apologize, Ymir."
Ymir: "I'm sorry...
Touya... Good luck..."
Yamato: "Ymir..."
Touya: "..."
Sisk: "We're about to make contact with the 'Sorge Field.'"
Miyasco: "I don't see anything unusual."
Celica: "Visually, no. But it's definitely there..."
Celica: "...See?"
Derock: "Don't 'See?' me.
That noise sounds bad.
It's so bright. We've got to do something."
Celica: "I told you it would be fine, didn't I?
Deploy protective field!"
Derock: "I think we're shaking even more than before.
This is bad. It's not working after all."
Celica: "I! Told! You! There's nothing to worry about.
My 'Charge Buddy No. 3' is perfect!"
Sisk: "We're through..."
Celica: "See? What did I tell you?"
Derock: "That's Lady Celica for you.
I-I believed in you from the start."
Celica: "..."
Miyasco: "C-Come to think of it, Ymir...
I haven't seen her around..."
Celica: "...If she still hasn't come back by now...
It must have gone well...
What... am I even doing...?"
Miyasco: "Lady... Celica?"
Celica: "Huh? O-Oh, yes. Where could she have gone?"
Miyasco: "..."
Celica: "Anyway, more importantly, it's about time we got ready
to sortie. I'll leave the rest to you, then."
Captain Roa: "Hmm."
Derock: "Cheer up, Lady Celica.
Life has its ups and downs, you know.
Ai told me that."
Celica: "Hmm. Is that some kind of proverb? Oh, well.
...More to the point, Derock, I didn't expect you to cheer me up.
I think a little better of you now."
Derock: "I'm on your side, Lady Celica.
Besides, romance under unusual circumstances doesn't last.
I'll seize that opening and... Gwegh! Gwegh!"
Celica: "...I take that back."
Ymir: "..."
Sisk: "Oh..."
Celica: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "..."
Celica: "I see... Honestly, that guy...
I'll go teach him a little lesson..."
Ymir: "...Thank you. But please don't.
I'll stay here and protect the place he'll come back to.
That's enough for me..."
Celica: "Ymir..."
Ymir: "I'm sorry I'm late."
Celica: "Are you all right?"
Ymir: "Yes. Don't worry. Now's the time to focus on
the battle ahead. There's no time for distractions."
Celica: "I see... All right.
I'll be off for a bit, then."
Ymir: "Take care."
Celica: "Leave it to me. See you!"
Ai: "Whaaat?!"
Clovis: "Hey, hey. Are you serious?"
Fain: "Y-Ymir's going aboard Rayblade...?"
Arthur: "...It seems you are serious."
Ymir: "Yes."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan, is that true?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Aurelie: "Well, if Touya's decided, it's not our place
to complain.
Besides, anyone can guess from how close you two are standing."
Ymir: "Oh..."
Kasumi: "..."
Ai: "...Sigh. Well, I sort of expected it...
But to think you'd really end up with Ymir."
Ymir: "E-End up with..."
Ai: "Honestly, I really let my guard down...
But these things are up to the people involved,
and complaining would just make me look bad.
Yes, yes, I get it. I'll graciously admit defeat,
and quietly step aside..."
Touya: "Ai... You..."
Aurelie: "What? Don't tell me...
You hadn't noticed Ai's feelings?!"
Ai: "Don't bother. He's as oblivious as a primitive life-form.
Right, Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "Huh? W-Well..."
Ai: "We losers should console each other
and make our exit... Right?"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Do you really... love Ymir...?"
Touya: "...Yeah."
Kasumi: "O-Oh... I..."
Ai: "Okay, stop! We don't have time to mope over
broken hearts. Let's turn those feelings into anger
and take it out on them! Right, Kasumi?"
Kasumi: "...Y-You're right...
You're hurting too, Ai-chan...
I can't be the only one moping..."
Touya: "Kasumi... Um..."
Kasumi: "No! Touya-chan, you're so kind...
If you say something like that to me now..."
Ai: "Come on, don't cry. Hold it in, hold it in!
Let's hurry up and forget that jerk.
Oh, why don't you go out with me instead?"
Kasumi: "Huh?!"
Ai: "You know, Kasumi, I've always thought
you were pretty great."
Kasumi: "H-Hang on..."
Ai: "Oh, I forgot to mention. My school
is a girls' school."
Kasumi: "A-Ai-chan... I'm not into that sort of thing...
W-Well, bye!"
Ai: "Oh! Get back here!"
Touya: "...So that's what Ai's like..."
Touya: "Oww! Wh-What was that for?!
Waaah! A-All right, I get it! Stop biting me!"
Yamato: "...Honestly...
Ai's the one who wants to cry most, you know?
She's forcing herself to joke around."
Touya: "Huh...?"
Ymir: "Ai..."
Clovis: "Well, everyone would've found out sooner or later.
Maybe it's better this way."
Arthur: "It's easy to be liked by everyone,
but not being disliked by anyone isn't the same
as being liked by everyone."
Fain: "Touya. Ordinarily, for making Kasumi cry,
I'd put you to the sword.
But I can't cut down the man Ymir loves.
Touya... Don't make Ymir cry.
If you do..."
Touya: "Yeah. If that happens, you can have my head,
or whatever else you want."
Fain: "There's no deceit in those eyes, then.
But... Why are you the only one who's so popular...?"
Arthur: "Well, it's all right, isn't it?
Now then, shall we be on our way...?"
Yamato: "I hope this is the last time we have to board Rayblade."
Touya: "Yeah."
Yamato: "...Now, about your partner this time...
You understand, don't you?"
Touya: "Understand what?"
Yamato: "Don't 'Understand what?' me.
This time, you choose the person you truly need, Touya,
the one you want beside you to the very end."
Touya: "The person I want beside me..."
Yamato: "Look, here they come.
Think carefully before you choose!"
Mechanic A: "All right! As soon as Rayblade launches,
we'll launch the others in order!"
Mechanic C: "Huh? Touya and the others are already aboard Rayblade,
aren't they? Why haven't they launched?"
Mechanic F: "...You're pretty oblivious yourself.
We can't interrupt someone's romance, can we?"
Mechanic C: "...Oh, right. I get it.
Lovers, huh...? That's a word that has nothing to do with me..."
Mechanic F: "...You really are oblivious..."
Ai: "Hey, Touya. When this battle's over,
do you think we can go back to our own world?"
Touya: "Who knows? But Wenimas said she'd be waiting.
That must mean when our job in this world
is done, we can go back. Doesn't it?"
Ai: "Our job... You mean defeating Debish and the others?"
Touya: "Or getting Debish to change his ways
so we can stop their plan...
Though I doubt that'll happen."
Ai: "Then this will be the last battle, right?
In that case, want to meet up when we're back in our own world?"
Touya: "Huh? Sure, I don't mind..."
Ai: "Then we could see a movie, go to an outdoor cafe
for tea, then take a walk in a park..."
Touya: "H-Hey, isn't that...?"
Ai: "It's a little ordinary, but I thought that might be
a nice way to start... You know?"
Touya: "..."
Ai: "Oh, I-I'm not saying you have to. But..."
Touya: "Sure."
Ai: "Huh?!"
Touya: "Let's win this battle, go back to our world,
and meet up. That's where our time together will start."
Ai: "...Yeah. Let's make sure we win this battle."
Touya: "Yeah."
Kasumi: "Touya-chan...
What am I to you, Touya-chan?"
Touya: "Huh?"
Kasumi: "I love you, Touya-chan. I really love you.
But, Touya-chan, do you...
still see me as just a childhood friend...?"
Touya: "Come to think of it, I never answered you back then."
Kasumi: "...No."
Touya: "I feel... Well... Hahaha. It's embarrassing
saying it so formally..."
Kasumi: "..."
Touya: "...Kasumi... I love you too.
We've always been together, so I've come to take it for granted.
But you're still the most important person to me.
Until now, we've been close friends,
but how about becoming a close couple from now on?"
Kasumi: "...Y-Yes! Of course!
I'm so happy... Somehow... It's like a dream... I..."
Touya: "H-Hey, don't cry... You really haven't changed.
Here, wipe your tears with this."
Kasumi: "You haven't changed either, Touya-chan.
You're still so kind..."
Touya: "R-Really?"
Kasumi: "Yes."
Touya: "W-Well, anyway, if we're going to get back to our own world,
we can't lose this battle.
We'll win. And then... Let's go home together."
Kasumi: "Yes!"
Kasumi: "Touya-chan... Let's go."
Touya: "Are you all right?"
Kasumi: "Yes. I'm fine as long as I'm with you, Touya-chan."
Touya: "...All right. Let's go settle this."
Kasumi: "Yes!"
Celica: "...It's finally time."
Touya: "Yeah."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "...H-Hey.
What do you think of me, Touya?"
Touya: "Huh? Wh-What do I...?"
Celica: "...Am I just another companion?
Or a princess who doesn't act like one?"
Touya: "Hmm... Well, you are a princess.
You may not look it, but that doesn't change the facts."
Celica: "I see... Right. It's always like this.
Whenever I make friends, they find out I'm royalty,
and draw a line between us. I know it can't be helped.
But... If it means feeling like this, I wish I hadn't been born
into royalty..."
Touya: "Why are you getting so gloomy? It's not like you."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "...It's true that you're a princess, Celica.
But I've always tried to treat you as a girl."
Celica: "...Huh?"
Touya: "Besides, royalty or commoner,
someone's essence doesn't change over something so superficial.
Celica is Celica.
Your status doesn't matter to me.
You're down-to-earth, always positive, and you love your little brother...
That's the you... I love."
Celica: "Touya..."
Touya: "Though, covered in oil, in a room with parts scattered everywhere...
I do have to wonder about you sleeping so soundly there."
Celica: "Wh-What's that supposed to mean?! What's wrong with that?
I feel more at home there..."
Touya: "Hahaha. I'm kidding.
That unpretentious side of you is part of who you are, Celica."
Celica: "Oh, you........ But I'm glad.
That you feel the same way, Touya."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "..."
Touya: "..."
Celica: "Oh! O-Of course..."
Celica: "I... love you too, Touya."
Touya: "R-Really...? I'm glad..."
Celica: "Well then... Let's go."
Touya: "Yeah."
Touya: "Well, it's about time we left..."
Aurelie: "..."
Touya: "...What's wrong?"
Aurelie: "Hey, why did you choose me?
Instead of Ai or Kasumi?"
Touya: "Did... you not want me to?"
Aurelie: "It's not that. I don't understand myself.
Part of me is so happy inside, but another part can't just
be happy about it... Even though I love you so much, Touya."
Touya: "!?"
Aurelie: "...What's wrong?"
Touya: "N-Nothing. That came out of nowhere,
so I wasn't ready for it."
Aurelie: "Huh? Oh... Why is that?
I could never say it before..."
Touya: "..."
Aurelie: "I... Maybe I was overthinking things.
I've only ever dated older people,
so maybe I convinced myself I could only date someone older...
That made me unsure of myself, and I kept looking for
a reason to be in love..."
Touya: "You don't need a reason to fall for someone.
Hearing you say honestly how you feel made me happy."
Aurelie: "...Yeah. I need to be more honest with myself.
But... It might take me a while.
So, would you stay with me until then?"
Touya: "Yeah. I'll watch you become more honest, Aurelie,
with my own eyes."
Aurelie: "Hehehehe... What a strange feeling.
I feel warm somehow..."
Touya: "A younger guy isn't so bad, is he?"
Aurelie: "...Idiot."
Kururu: "...Touya."
Touya: "What is it?"
Kururu: "Remember when I said I'd make you my husband?
I take it back."
Touya: "..."
Kururu: "This battle's going to be even harder
than any we've fought before, isn't it?
If either of us dies,
those words would bind the other.
I don't want that..."
Touya: "You make it sound like you're going to die."
Kururu: "...I'll protect you, Touya. I will!"
Touya: "...Neither of us is going to die. No, I won't let anyone
die in this battle. We're all coming back here alive."
Kururu: "...Touya..."
Touya: "So don't say things like that... All right?"
Kururu: "Okay. Then when this battle's over,
we'll have our wedding!"
Touya: "Huh? N-No... That's...
I mean, look, you're still only 12, right?
It won't hurt to wait a little longer before thinking about it..."
Kururu: "...Sob."
Touya: "Oh... H-Hey, Kururu...?"
Kururu: "Sob... How cruel... You were just playing with me after all."
Touya: "...Sigh. I'm not falling for that."
Kururu: "Tch. You caught me."
Touya: "Honestly, you..."
Kururu: "Oh, well. I don't care what we call
our relationship. As long as we both know how important
we are to each other, that's enough."
Touya: "Kururu... You're right.
Maybe it's because I'm with you that I can go into battle so confidently."
Kururu: "Ehehehe. Well then, let's go settle this!"
Touya: "Yeah."
